title: ECG
what: A recording of your heart's electrical activity. Small pads are stuck on your skin. No electricity goes into you. It is safe.
why: For chest pain, skipped beats, shortness of breath, checkups, and before surgery.

prepare.title: Preparation
prepare.text: No special prep needed. Do not put lotion or oil on your chest. The pads stick less well.

prepare.title: Before the test
prepare.text: Do not rush in. Sit for 5 minutes to let your pulse settle.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Wear something comfortable. Your chest, wrists, and ankles need to be bare. Tights are best avoided.

steps: You lie on your back with your chest, wrists, and ankles bare
Gel or sticky pads called electrodes are put on your skin
Lie still and do not talk for about a minute
The machine prints the recording, and the pads are removed
feel: Nothing, except maybe the cool gel
after: You get the reading right away, or it goes to your doctor
You can go back to your day straight away
red_flags: If you have chest pain right now, do not wait for the test. Call emergency services

faq.q: Will an ECG give me an electric shock?
faq.a: No. The machine only records your heart's tiny signals. It sends nothing into your body.
